blocks.content: Install Data Sync Pro from the [Salesforce AppExchange](https://appexchange.salesforce.com/appxListingDetail?listingId=a0N4V00000Gk6NRUAZ).
On the installation screen, select only "Install for Admins Only" or "Install for Specific Profiles...".
After the installation completes, assign the appropriate permission set(s) to each user. See [[permissions|Permission Sets]]^ for details.
